howtoSummary.message: How to get a free DeepL key

howto1.message: Go to {a}deepl.com/pro-api{/a} and choose the free plan (Free).

howto2.message: Sign up. DeepL asks for a bank card to verify your account — you won’t be charged on the free plan.

howto3.message: In your account, open “API Keys” and copy your key — it ends with “:fx”.

howto4.message: Paste the key into the field above — the extension checks it right away.

howtoFree.message: Free: 500,000 characters a month. You’ll see how much is left right here, under the key.

llmNote.message: Your key stays in this browser. AI conveys meaning and phrasing better, but it’s slower than DeepL, and every translation is billed to your account with the service.

formalityNote.message: Works only for some languages: German, French, Italian, Spanish, Dutch, Polish, Portuguese, Russian and Japanese. Other languages aren’t affected.

displayReplace.message: In place of the original text

noTranslateNote.message: Separate with commas or new lines: names, terms. Works with DeepL and AI only — the built-in translator can’t do this.

step1Hint.message: You can change it anytime in the extension window.

step2Text.message: Chrome’s built-in translator runs on your computer: it’s free, needs no keys, and your text isn’t sent anywhere.

shiftChoice.message: — recommended. Point at some text, then press and release Shift. Press it again to bring back the original. Nothing gets translated by accident while you just move the mouse or scroll.

dwellChoice.message: Rest the cursor on some text and it gets translated. Move the cursor away to bring back the original. Links, buttons, menus and short labels aren’t translated by hovering.

step5.message: Pin the icon to the toolbar

pinText.message: Click the Extensions icon (the puzzle piece) to the right of the address bar, then the pin next to “$name$”. The icon opens the settings and the “Translate page” button, and a “!” on it tells you if translation stops working.

pinHint.message: Reload any tabs that were open before you installed the extension — translation will work on them after that.

extraText.message: You can connect DeepL or AI (ChatGPT, Claude) with your own key: in the extension window, open “Translation quality”, choose a translator and paste your key. A DeepL key is free for 500,000 characters a month; get one at {a}deepl.com/pro-api{/a} (sign-up required). Keep in mind: the text you translate is then sent to DeepL or the AI service you chose — the extension asks for your consent before sending anything.
